description: This Rust source file defines data structures and functions for parsing and representing the output of cargo build commands, including handling rustc invocations, cargo metadata, and command-line arguments related to crate types and compilation options.

classes.name: Crate
classes.description: Represents a Rust crate with metadata such as name, version, crate types, target, features, external dependencies, compilation flags, and source paths.

classes.name: CrateType
classes.description: Enumeration of possible crate types, including binary, library, dynamic library, procedural macro, and test variants.

methods.name: parse_cargo_out
methods.description: Reads and parses cargo output and metadata files to produce a list of Crate objects representing the build artifacts.

methods.name: Crate::from_rustc_invocation
methods.description: Creates a Crate instance from a rustc command line string and associated workspace metadata.
